title: Runtime Session Overview
description: Orient yourself in Runtime Session: learn how the category rail, the Runtime Session section rail, and the loaded page fit together before taking any action.
before_you_start: You can read this guide with the engine stopped. It opens settings pages and highlights controls; changes and tests are explicit user actions.
learning_outcomes: Recognize the category rail and the Runtime Session section rail as separate navigation levels
Tell which Runtime Session section is currently loaded
Know which sibling sections exist so you can pick the right one next

steps.title: Understand Runtime Session
steps.body: Runtime Session brings together the parts NC uses for a conversation: session input, resources, language, transcription, speech output, images and avatars. This overview stays here. The Runtime settings rail also contains separate areas such as Vision Sensors and Document Memory; those have their own guides.

steps.title: Read the section rail
steps.body: Find Session setup, Resources, LLM, Speech-to-text, Text-to-speech, Visual reply and Avatar in the inner rail. Each opens one configuration page. The values beneath the icons summarize your stack; opening a settings page does not mean its provider is active or loaded.

steps.title: Distinguish configuration from a running session
steps.body: A viewed provider, an active provider and a loaded model are different states. Read the active-stack summary before changing anything. This guide does not start NC or load models. Use Your first chat if you want the complete first-run exercise.
